extraction.description: The screenshot shows UiPath Agent Builder/Studio Web with the Data manager panel open on the Inputs schema. A JSON editor is visible defining an object input schema with required fields Monthly_Gross_Income and Household_Size, including properties for household size and monthly gross income. The editor includes line numbers, syntax highlighting, and a minimap on the right.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on Data manager, then select Inputs. In the Inputs JSON editor, enter or verify the input schema defining Monthly_Gross_Income and Household_Size as required fields, with Household_Size configured as an integer and Monthly_Gross_Income configured as a string.
